# Product Requirements Document: Team Collaboration Platform

**Generated by**: Coder1 PRD Generator  
**Date**: October 3, 2025  
**Version**: 1.0

---

## Executive Summary

A modern SaaS platform designed to streamline remote team collaboration across different time zones, providing real-time visibility into project progress, task management, and team communication.

---

## Problem Statement

Remote teams struggle to track project progress across different time zones, leading to:
- Delayed decision-making due to asynchronous communication
- Duplicated work when team members aren't aware of others' progress
- Difficulty identifying blockers until stand-up meetings
- Lost context when switching between multiple communication tools

**Target Users**: Remote-first software development teams (5-50 members), particularly those with engineers distributed across 3+ time zones.

---

## Target Users

### Primary Personas

**1. Engineering Manager (Sarah, 35)**
- Needs: Clear visibility into team velocity and blockers
- Pain Points: Spends 2+ hours daily coordinating across timezones
- Goals: Reduce coordination overhead by 50%

**2. Senior Developer (Marcus, 28)**  
- Needs: Async context sharing without interrupting flow state
- Pain Points: Context-switching between Slack, Jira, GitHub, Notion
- Goals: Consolidate tools and reduce interruptions

**3. Product Manager (Lisa, 32)**
- Needs: Real-time project status without constant status meetings
- Pain Points: Difficulty tracking feature progress across sprints
- Goals: Make data-driven decisions with live dashboards

---

## Core Features

### Must-Have (MVP)

**1. Real-Time Activity Feed**
- Live updates from connected tools (GitHub, Jira, Figma)
- Filterable by project, person, or activity type
- Timezone-aware timestamps showing "2 hours ago in their timezone"

**2. Async Stand-ups**
- Daily digest system with structured prompts
- Video/text/screenshot support
- AI-generated summaries for managers

**3. Project Dashboard**
- Sprint burndown charts with predictive completion dates
- Blocker detection via keyword analysis
- Team capacity visualization across timezones

**4. Unified Search**
- Search across all integrated tools in one interface
- Context-aware results (prioritizes relevant projects)
- Natural language queries: "what Marcus shipped yesterday"

### Nice-to-Have (Post-MVP)

- Slack/Teams integration for notifications
- Mobile apps for on-the-go updates
- Advanced analytics (team health scores, velocity trends)
- Custom workflow automation

---

## Success Metrics

### North Star Metric
**Weekly Active Collaboration Hours** - Time teams spend actively using the platform to coordinate work

### Primary KPIs

**Engagement Metrics**:
- Daily active users (target: 80% of team)
- Average session duration (target: 15+ minutes)
- Stand-up completion rate (target: 90%+)

**Efficiency Metrics**:
- Reduction in status meetings (target: -40%)
- Time to blocker resolution (target: <4 hours)
- Tool-switching reduction (target: -60%)

**Business Metrics**:
- Monthly Recurring Revenue (target: $50k MRR in 6 months)
- Net Promoter Score (target: 50+)
- Customer retention rate (target: 95%+)

### Success Criteria
- 100 paying teams within 6 months
- Average team size of 12 users
- $49/user/month pricing validated
- <5% monthly churn

---

## Technical Constraints

### Technology Stack

**Frontend**: 
- React 18+ with TypeScript
- TailwindCSS for styling
- Real-time updates via WebSocket

**Backend**:
- Node.js + Express
- PostgreSQL for relational data
- Redis for caching and real-time features

**Infrastructure**:
- Vercel for frontend hosting
- Railway/Render for backend
- Cloudflare for CDN and DDoS protection

### Integration Requirements
- GitHub API (webhooks for real-time updates)
- Jira REST API (issue tracking sync)
- Figma API (design file activity)
- OAuth 2.0 for authentication

### Performance Requirements
- Page load time: <2 seconds
- Real-time update latency: <500ms
- 99.9% uptime SLA
- Support 1000+ concurrent users per instance

### Compliance & Security
- SOC 2 Type II certification (required for enterprise)
- GDPR compliance for EU customers
- End-to-end encryption for sensitive data
- SSO support (SAML, OAuth)

## Timeline & Milestones

**Phase 1 (Weeks 1-4)**: MVP Development
- Core dashboard and activity feed
- GitHub + Jira integration
- Basic async stand-ups

**Phase 2 (Weeks 5-8)**: Beta Launch
- 10 pilot teams onboarded
- Analytics dashboard
- Mobile-responsive design

**Phase 3 (Weeks 9-12)**: Public Launch
- ProductHunt launch
- Slack/Teams integration
- Advanced search features

## Appendix

### Competitor Analysis
- **Asana**: Strong task management, weak real-time collaboration
- **Linear**: Excellent for eng teams, limited cross-functional features
- **Notion**: Great docs, poor project tracking

### User Research Summary
- 15 interviews with remote engineering managers
- Common request: "Single source of truth without another meeting"
- Willingness to pay: $30-60/user/month for proven time savings
